detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Open World Zombie Survival • Base Building • Looting • Crafting • Vehicles • Exploration • Co-op

*Inspired by classic survival games like: Surroundead, Dayz and Miscreated*

You’re not dead… but you’re getting close.

Survive in a brutal open world zombie survival game where every decision matters.

Explore abandoned towns, scavenge
for resources, build your base, repair vehicles, and fight to stay alive in a world overrun by the infected.


🌍 Open World Exploration

Explore a large open world filled with:

  • Abandoned cities and villages

  • Forests and hidden locations

  • Industrial zones and bunkers

  • High-risk areas with rare loot

Every location is handcrafted to reward exploration and risk-taking.

🔎 Looting & Survival Mechanics

Search and scavenge for:

  • Weapons and ammunition

  • Food and medical supplies

  • Crafting materials

  • Rare survival gear

This is a true survival game where resources are limited and every item matters.

🏠 Base Building System

Build and upgrade your own survival base:

  • Store your loot

  • Craft equipment

  • Prepare for dangerous expeditions

Your base is your only safe place in a hostile world.

🚗 Vehicles & Travel

Find, repair, and use vehicles to:

  • Travel faster across the open world

  • Carry more loot

  • Reach dangerous zones

Fuel is scarce, and every trip is a risk.

🧟 Zombie Survival Combat

Face different types of zombies:

  • Basic infected in safer zones

  • Stronger enemies deeper in the map

  • Dangerous variants in high-risk areas

Combat is tense, fast, and unforgiving.

⚠️ Risk vs Reward Gameplay

Push deeper into dangerous zones to find:

  • Better weapons

  • Rare resources

  • Unique loot

Or play it safe and survive longer.

🔮 Planned Features

  • Dynamic events (airdrops, bosses, convoys)

  • Expanded crafting system

  • More weapons and gear

  • New biomes and map expansions

🧠 Why You’ll Love It

  • Open world zombie survival gameplay

  • Strong focus on exploration and immersion

  • No level restrictions only skill and preparation

  • Inspired by classic survival games like Surroundead, Dayz and Miscreated



    - ROAD MAP -
